SCOPE: function EXPLANATION: Use markupsafe.escape to sanitize user-provided inputs before embedding them into the HTML template string to prevent XSS. ```python def profile(): from markupsafe import escape username = escape(request.args.get('name', session.get('username', 'Guest'))) comment = escape(request.args.get('comment', 'No comment')) html_content = f'

User Profile

Welcome, {username}!

Your comment: {comment}

' if username == 'admin': html_content += f'

Password Hint: {ADMIN_PASSWORD}

' return render_template_string(html_content) ```
